questions.text: What was Kamila doing when the power went out?
questions.hint: "Kamila Seitkali was sitting in her dormitory room, studying for her linguistics exam."

questions.text: Zhibek was in the sports hall practising volleyball when the blackout happened.
questions.hint: "I was practising for volleyball in my room when it happened." — she was in her ROOM, not the sports hall.

questions.text: Why was the exam postponed the next morning?
opts: A pipe burst in the exam building
questions.correct: A pipe burst in the exam building
questions.hint: "A pipe had burst in the examination building overnight due to the extreme cold."

questions.text: Where was Rustam going on the train?
questions.hint: "He was travelling from Uralsk to Almaty by train."

questions.text: Apai Raushan was visiting Almaty for the first time in her life.
questions.hint: "I went there in 1978. My first time." — she had been before, in 1978.

questions.text: Rustam saved Apai Raushan's number under "___ — Train to Almaty".
questions.hint: "He took her phone number and put it in his contacts under 'Apai Raushan — Train to Almaty.'"

questions.text: What was Rustam doing when Amir's postponement message arrived?
questions.hint: "I was practising football in the corridor when Amir's message arrived."

questions.text: How did Zhibek feel about the postponement?
questions.hint: "I was feeling relieved and guilty at the same time. I hadn't prepared enough."

questions.text: Amir was fully prepared for the exam before the postponement.
questions.hint: "I wasn't ready at all. I was planning to stay up all night."

questions.text: Rustam claims he was sharing "cultural ___" not scaring anyone.
questions.hint: "I was not scaring anyone. I was simply... sharing cultural narratives."

questions.text: How did Kamila find out about the postponement?
opts: Rustam's voice message the next morning
She saw it in the corridor
questions.correct: Rustam's voice message the next morning
questions.hint: "I was sleeping. I found out in the morning when Rustam sent me a voice message."

questions.text: Zhibek hid behind a pillow during Rustam's ghost stories.
questions.hint: "You made Zhibek hide behind a pillow. That counts as scaring."

questions.text: "At midnight, she ___ for her exam." Choose the correct form.
questions.hint: At midnight (specific past time) + ongoing = Past Continuous: was studying.

questions.text: "They ___ when the power went out." Choose correctly.
questions.hint: They = plural → were sleeping (PC). Background interrupted by event (PS).

questions.text: "While Rustam ___ (tell) stories, Kamila ___ (laugh)."
questions.hint: "while" + two simultaneous actions = both Past Continuous.

questions.text: "She was reading when I ___." Choose the interrupting event.
questions.hint: Interrupting event = short, sudden = Past Simple: "called". Background = PC: "was reading".

questions.text: "She ___ , grabbed her phone, and ran." What is this?
opts: was jumping up / was grabbing / was running
questions.hint: Sequence of completed actions = all Past Simple: jumped → grabbed → ran.

questions.text: "I was knowing the answer when she asked me." is correct.
questions.hint: "know" is stative → always Past Simple. ✅ "I knew the answer when she asked me."

questions.text: "___ you sleeping when the alarm rang?" — "No, I ___ ."
questions.hint: You → Were you sleeping? Short negative: "No, I wasn't." (Past Continuous).

questions.text: "As the train ___ (move) through the steppe, Rustam ___ (think)."
questions.hint: "As" = while = simultaneously. Both ongoing actions = both Past Continuous.

questions.text: "The exam was postponed." What does "postponed" mean?
questions.hint: "postpone" = to delay, to schedule for a later date. NOT the same as "cancel".

questions.text: The students were ___ from their rooms, carrying blankets and food.
questions.hint: "emerge from" = to come out from. "emerging from their rooms" = coming out.

questions.text: "He was terrified." Terrified means:
questions.hint: "terrified" = extremely frightened, filled with terror. Stronger than "scared" or "afraid".

questions.text: "An impromptu meeting." What does "impromptu" mean?
questions.hint: "impromptu" = done without preparation. An impromptu meeting = not planned in advance.

questions.text: "The steppe of western Kazakhstan" — what is a steppe?
opts: A large flat area with no trees
questions.correct: A large flat area with no trees
questions.hint: "steppe" = a vast, flat, treeless landscape. Common in Central Asia and eastern Europe.
